states.name: after_check_1
states.description: Flamingo model is loaded and visible on the platform at ground level

states.name: after_check_2
states.description: At least 3 lantern objects are present in the scene floating around the platform

states.name: after_check_3
states.description: Lanterns have a visible glow or emissive material indicating they can be ignited

states.name: after_check_4
states.description: Clicking a lantern ignites it, changing its visual state (emissive intensity increases or color shifts to warm orange/red)

states.name: after_check_5
states.description: A thermal column particle effect or visual heat distortion appears above each ignited lantern

states.name: after_check_6
states.description: Heat intensity slider or UI control exists and adjusting it changes the stored heat value within safe biological limits (below a max threshold)

states.name: after_check_7
states.description: When enough lanterns are ignited in correct sequence with sufficient combined thermal output, the flamingo rises from the platform (y-position increases)

states.name: after_check_8
states.description: A temperature gauge or HUD element displays the current air temperature and indicates whether it is within safe biological limits

states.name: after_check_9
states.description: If temperature exceeds safe biological limits, a warning is displayed and the flamingo does not lift (safety constraint enforced)

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["flamingo","multi","asset","physics"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()
